hits.title: Software Development Engineer II (Remote @ Colombia)
hits.location:
Headquarters: Remote @ Colombia

About the role: 

The OfferUp Connect team builds the moments that turn a listing into a sale. Every chat between buyers and sellers, every offer notification, and every saved-search alert runs through services we own, from messaging and notifications to location, meetups, and the subscriptions sellers pay for. We run high-volume Java microservices and streaming pipelines, integrate with partners like Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, Apple, and Google, and use experimentation to decide what ships.

We also take on high-visibility work beyond our domain. Connect built OfferUp's video infrastructure for listing videos and LLM-powered catalog enrichment on Amazon Bedrock, both company priorities that changed what buyers see every day. The roadmap is wide open for someone who wants to help shape it.

As a Software Development Engineer II, you'll own features from concept to rollout: designing and writing well-tested code, launching experiments, and measuring results with Product, Design, and Data partners. You'll raise the quality of the code around you and get the chance to join the next project like video or catalog enrichment.

Here’s more of what you will get to do:

  • Design, build, and deploy backend services and event-driven pipelines for messaging, notifications, location, and subscriptions
  • Improve the reliability, latency, and delivery rates of high-volume messaging and notification systems, including retries, rate limiting, and frequency capping
  • Integrate with and operate third-party platforms such as Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, Apple and Google push services, and app store billing
  • Own features end-to-end: plan, design, develop, deploy, measure, and iterate
  • Break down complex engineering problems into achievable tasks and deliver them within committed timeframes
  • Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams (Product, Design, Data Science, Marketing, and iOS, Android, and web engineers) to design and implement new features
  • Contribute to A/B tests and use experimentation results to decide what ships
  • Actively participate in code reviews and enforce good patterns, testing, and edge-case handling
  • Coach and mentor junior team members, new hires, and interns
  • Create shared components, utilities, and services that improve team velocity across the stack
  • Maintain and improve the runbooks, alerting, and monitoring for the features you ship
  • Participate in a reasonable on-call rotation with the rest of the team
  • Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Gemini, and similar) to increase your daily development velocity and code quality
  • Become a subject matter expert in one or more of the team's sub-domains: messaging, notifications and campaigns, location, or subscriptions and promotions

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Demonstrated ability to own the delivery of multiple features end-to-end (plan, design, develop, and deploy) with high efficiency, including breaking down engineering problems into achievable tasks
  • Strong coding skills in Java, with a working understanding of microservices and distributed-systems fundamentals
  • Good knowledge of data structures and object-oriented design
  • Working knowledge of asynchronous, event-driven systems (queues, pub/sub, or streams), including retries and idempotent processing
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (Claude Code or similar) in a real engineering workflow, and a point of view on when they help and when they don't
  • A habit of following good coding patterns, writing appropriate tests, considering trade-offs, and seeking out edge cases
  • Comfortable giving and receiving feedback in code reviews
  • A bias toward shipping, learning from production, and iterating quickly
  • An insatiable desire and ability to learn
  • BS or MS in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience

Helpful, but not required:

  • Fluency in another modern object-oriented programming language
  • Experience with TypeScript and Node.js
  • Experience with Agile development
  • Experience building and integrating with REST APIs
  • Experience with AWS services such as DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, Lambda, and ElastiCache (Redis)
  • Experience with notification and engagement platforms (Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, APNs, FCM) or in-app subscription billing (App Store, Google Play)
  • Experience with stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink or Kafka Streams
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (Statsig, LaunchDarkly, Optimizely) and analytics warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake)
  • Experience consuming or integrating LLM-based APIs (e.g., Bedrock, Vertex AI, OpenAI)
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines



About OfferUp:

OfferUp is dedicated to creating the simplest and most trusted way for people to buy, sell, and connect in their local communities. One of the top local marketplace apps for local buyers and sellers in the U.S., OfferUp makes it easy for people to discover more of what they need—from great deals and secondhand goods to jobs, services, home rentals, and more—right in their own communities. Our trusted platform empowers millions to connect, thrive, and move life forward. 

Available on iOS and Android, OfferUp has consistently ranked among the top shopping apps. Founded in 2011 and based in Bellevue, WA, OfferUp serves local markets nationwide and was used by more than 1 in 6 adults in the U.S. in 2024. OfferUp is backed by leading investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Warburg Pincus, GGV Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Coatue Management. https://about.offerup.com

More About OfferUp At a Glance

  • Top 10 Shopping app in the App Store and Google Play Store for three years
  • 15%+ of adults in several major markets use OfferUp every month (LA, Miami, Phoenix, Seattle, Las Vegas, Riverside, Orlando)
  • OfferUp works directly with nearly 2000 US law enforcement agencies to build trust in local communities

OfferUp is unleashing the power of local, and we’ve built a dynamic team to do it. To learn more about working at OfferUp, check out https://about.offerup.com/people

hits.title: Senior Deployment Engineer with LLM and GPU Infrastructure experience
hits.location:
Headquarters:

Summary

We are seeking an Infrastructure Engineer for Air-gapped LLM Deployments to support secure, large-scale software deployments in GPU-based environments. The role focuses on deploying LLM workloads in air-gapped settings and establishing observability with Grafana and Prometheus, with onsite presence in Riyadh required for two weeks per month.

General information

They need a senior engineer who can take ownership of complex deployments across isolated or air-gapped environments. The role will involve working with GPU infrastructure for LLM workloads and ensuring systems can be deployed, monitored, and maintained reliably at scale.

The engineer should be comfortable troubleshooting infrastructure and deployment issues, automating deployment processes, and working with observability platforms such as Grafana and Prometheus.

Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
Onsite requirement: A few times per quarter in Riyadh

Tasks and Deliverables

Design and support air-gapped deployment environments for LLM-based systems.

Deploy and optimize LLM workloads on GPU infrastructure.

Support large-scale software deployments across secure environments.

Implement and maintain observability using Grafana and Prometheus.

Collaborate onsite in Riyadh to assess, deploy, and troubleshoot environment-specific issues.

Required experience

Expertise in air-gapped deployments.

Experience with large-scale software deployments.

Experience deploying LLMs on GPUs.

Hands-on experience with Grafana and Prometheus.

Engagement highlights

Senior-level infrastructure/deployment engineering role.

Work on large-scale GPU and LLM infrastructure.

Challenging deployment scenarios involving air-gapped environments.

Full-time, long-term position

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-senior-deployment-engineer-with-llm-and-gpu-infrastructure-experience

hits.title: Analytics Engineer II, Full Stack (Revenue Analytics)
hits.location:
Headquarters: Remote Poland

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

We’re looking for a curious, driven professional to join our Revenue Analytics team. This builds and owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that power Affirm’s Revenue organization.
As a Senior Analyst, Revenue Analytics, you’ll build scalable data products that power day-to-day decision-making - owning end-to-end work across data modeling, metric definitions, dashboards, automation, and enablement. 
You’ll also help strengthen our semantic layer and data governance, laying the foundation for reliable AI. The ideal candidate combines strong technical and analytical skills with the ability to turn ambiguous business questions into durable, well-tested data infrastructure.

What you'll do 

  • Develop dbt data models, dashboards, metrics, and automation processes for the revenue field team and revenue analysts

  • Build and maintain critical reporting data models that power external merchant reporting 

  • Build the semantic, metadata, and context layers that allow AI systems to accurately understand Revenue data, metrics, and business definitions

  • Partner with Business Systems, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into durable, well-tested data products

  • Contribute to the team’s best practices in version control, code review, documentation, and release hygiene (GitHub-based workflows)

  • Develop processes, governance, and foundations to scale the impact of analytics within Revenue.


What we look for 

  • 3+ years of work experience in an analytics engineering or business intelligence role

  • Strong working knowledge of SQL, dbt, Python, data modeling, and data visualization 

  • Hands-on experience with BI tools (Sigma/Looker/Tableau), Databricks, and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake)

  • Understanding of the data foundations required for reliable AI, including semantic layers, metadata, evals, metric definitions, documentation, and data quality

  • Demonstrated experience integrating AI tools into day-to-day analytics engineering workflows to improve development speed, quality, and scalability

  • Familiarity with Salesforce and experience supporting commercial areas of the business

  • Ability to identify user needs and translate them into robust, scalable data products

  • Ability to start with an ambiguous problem, deconstruct it into tangible steps, and work toward an impactful solution

  • Ability to communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Total rewards

We believe the people building honest financial products at Affirm should share in its success. That's why our total rewards are designed to support your health, growth, financial well-being, and future.

In service of our mission, we reward employees through a combination of base pay, equity (from parent company), and comprehensive benefits.

Base Pay Grade - K
226 000 zł  -  346 000 zł      

Base pay ranges and placement within those ranges are determined based on several factors, including role, experience, and job-related skills.

In addition to base pay, all employees in this role are eligible to receive equity from the parent company each year. This means as Affirm’s parent company grows, employees have the opportunity to share in that growth financially.

Equity Grade - 2 (awarded in US Dollars)

Affirm Holdings, Inc. Equity Grade example

Equity grade: 2
New hire equity: $16,000-$24,000
Annual Refresh: $5,000
Reward equity: $0-$75,000

Affirm also provides flexible spending wallets to all employees for technology and wellbeing related needs, which are reimbursable up to 1390 zł per month.

In addition to your compensation, our comprehensive benefits are designed to support you and the people who matter most. Benefits include:

  • Competitive paid time off, paid public holidays, and additional paid Away Days to rest and recharge.
  • Comprehensive private healthcare through Lux Med's Platinum package.
  • A MultiSport card to support your health and well-being.
  • Learning and development programs to help you grow professionally. 
  • Family healthcare support through Maven and parental leave support through Parentaly.
  • Mental well-being support through Lyra, including up to 12 confidential counseling or coaching sessions each year for you and your household members.
  • Financial well-being support through Northstar, with unlimited access to Certified Financial Advisors and planning tools at no cost to you.
  • Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that foster connection and inclusion.
  • Eligibility for creative tax benefits, subject to applicable law, role, and company policy.

Location - Remote Poland

The majority of our roles can be located anywhere in Poland.

**This job description is not a contractual document, and is not intended to have binding force.**

#LI-Remote

Remote-first with flexibility built in
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for you
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.
